description.en:
A3 is AgiBot's humanoid platform for dynamic performances, commercial events and developer applications. Its design emphasizes expressive whole-body movement and coordinated multi-robot routines. The manufacturer describes ultra-wideband positioning and 5G connectivity for deployment, with LinkCraft tools for creating customized motions.

A3 is listed at approximately 173 cm tall and 55 kg. Its transport workflow includes folding and entering its carrying case, helping operators move the platform between venues. Dual hot-swappable batteries support extended sessions, although actual operating time depends on activity. AgiBot also positions the platform for education and robotics development, alongside its more visible entertainment and promotional uses.
